query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('F_HC PLAN'[Region], "HC Plan gốc", SUM('F_HC PLAN'[HC Plan]), "HC Current gốc", SUM('F_HC PLAN'[HC Current]), "Vacant gốc", SUM('F_HC PLAN'[Vacant]), "Số dòng", COUNTROWS('F_HC PLAN')), FILTER('F_HC PLAN', YEAR('F_HC PLAN'[Report Month]) = 2026 && MONTH('F_HC PLAN'[Report Month]) = 10)) ORDER BY 'F_HC PLAN'[Region]
